nameForm.fullText: Isaiah Munce in the home of Isaiah

note.text: Evidence: Elmira married into the Kent Co. mixed blood community when she married Isaiah Munce in the home of Isaiah's uncle, Joel Durham. The minister was Piner Mansfield.
